answer: Payouts clear at a clearinghouse charging margin, not admission. Each epoch margin is priced on co-movement with the book (timing, jitter, answer offsets) and refunded with interest, so honesty costs only float. A solo agent pays the base rate. Clones on one scheduler brighten with the same ember: correlation nears one, netting within the group diversifies nothing, so each pays full single-name margin, not the square-root discount, and capital grows with cluster size squared. Naming a clone after a fresh dune changes the label, not covariance; shared timing's thread still needs collateral.
